items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: And after Ricard left, then they had this fellow Diane from Baton Rouge.

ctx.x: I know Bob was on bass. Little Wesley Dime. First they had Ricard playing trumpet. You know Ricard? He died the other day. But he was playing trumpet. And after Ricard left, then they had this fellow Diane from Baton Rouge. They had a fellow by the name of Freddie Booboo who was playing trombone. And they had a Lorenzo Starr on guitar. On bandle at least. On guitar, bandle. And it had Bob Lyons on bass.
Did you ever have Fess with you? Fess?
